subject.title: [Feature] Decouple dreaming from memory-core — allow any memory plugin to implement dreaming protocol

question: Should OpenClaw define a public memory dreaming plugin protocol, or keep dreaming orchestration plugin-owned and ClawHub-only after the role-slot work?
rationale: Current main only provides memory-core sidecar/config routing; the requested change would create a durable plugin SDK, config, scheduler, and state contract.

options.title: Design protocol after role slots
options.body: Use #88504 as foundation, then design a narrow MemoryDreamingProvider-style contract with lifecycle, storage, tests, docs, and upgrade behavior.

options.title: Keep orchestration plugin-owned
options.body: Document that vector-native dreaming should live in ClawHub plugins such as memory-lancedb-dreaming without a core-managed dreaming protocol.

options.title: Close as routing-covered
options.body: Treat memory.dreaming role-slot routing as enough and decline a separate dreaming invocation/storage protocol.

recommendation.title: Design protocol after role slots
recommendation.body: Use #88504 as foundation, then design a narrow MemoryDreamingProvider-style contract with lifecycle, storage, tests, docs, and upgrade behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a public plugin SDK and product architecture decision rather than a narrow bug repair.
